passages.text: Court records and news archives identify John Joubert as the most recent person executed in Nebraska. His case was reviewed by multiple courts, and the final appeal was denied only days before the execution. Advocates on both sides of the death penalty debate often cite the case to illustrate their arguments. The question of who was last executed in the state has a clear answer in his name.
